from pathlib import Path
import json,lzma,shutil
from scripts import phase_4j76_source_resolution as j
from scripts.validate_phase_4j76_receipt import coverage
j.scope()
out=j.ROOT/'validation'
checks_names=('terminal_tests','ruff','compileall','pip_supported','J75_receipt','J74_receipt','J73_receipt','C1_receipt','offline_replay','relocated_replay','source_originals','diff')
logs=out/'logs'; logs.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
for p in sorted(Path('/tmp').glob('island-j76-*.log')):
 (logs/p.name.removeprefix('island-j76-')).with_suffix('.log.xz').write_bytes(lzma.compress(p.read_bytes()))
attempts=out/'fenced'; attempts.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
runs=[]; inventory=[]
for p in sorted(Path('/tmp').glob('island-j76-*')):
 if not p.is_dir() or not (p/'result.json').is_file(): continue
 name=p.name.removeprefix('island-j76-')
 dst=attempts/name; (dst/'bootstrap').mkdir(parents=True)
 for n in ('policy.json','result.json','bootstrap/sitecustomize.py'):
  shutil.copyfile(p/n,dst/n)
 raw=(p/'events.jsonl').read_bytes(); result=j.read(p/'result.json')
 j.require(j.j75.old.sha_bytes(raw)==result['events_sha256'],'completed_event_ledger_changed')
 (dst/'events.jsonl.xz').write_bytes(lzma.compress(raw))
 runs.append(str(dst.relative_to(j.ROOT)))
 inventory.append({'name':name,'returncode':result['returncode'],'policy_sha256':j.pin(p/'policy.json'),'events_sha256':result['events_sha256']})
j.write(out/'fenced-runs.json',runs)
j.write(out/'attempts.json',inventory)
for p in sorted(Path('/tmp').glob('island-j76-*.xml')):
 (out/(p.name.removeprefix('island-j76-')+'.xz')).write_bytes(lzma.compress(p.read_bytes()))
shutil.copyfile('/tmp/island-j76-terminal_tests-0.xml', '/tmp/island-j76-terminal-test-preserved.xml')
(out/'terminal.xml.xz').write_bytes(lzma.compress(Path('/tmp/island-j76-terminal_tests-0.xml').read_bytes()))
shutil.copyfile('/tmp/island-j76-terminal_tests-0.collection.json',out/'collection.json')
for n in ('focused-0','focused-1'):
 shutil.copyfile('/tmp/island-j76-'+n+'.collection.json',out/(n+'.collection.json'))
checks=[]
for name in checks_names:
 result=j.read(Path('/tmp')/('island-j76-'+name+'-0')/'result.json')
 j.require(result['returncode']==0,'terminal_check_failed:'+name)
 checks.append({'name':name,'returncode':result['returncode'],'log':'validation/logs/'+name+'-0.log.xz'})
j.write(out/'checks.json',checks)
j.write(out/'retained-failures.json',{'failed_runs':[v for v in inventory if v['returncode']!=0],'corrections':{'reparse-0':'Identical sodium equivalences now retain both source declarations; conflicting mappings rejected. Superseded capture/derived metadata retained.','ruff-precommit-0':'Non-allowlisted Ruff path rejected before launch; named frozen allowlist Ruff invocation passes.'},'superseded_capture':'validation/superseded-capture-0','earlier_focused_runs_add_no_unique_terminal_coverage':True})
print(json.dumps({'coverage':coverage(j.ROOT),'completed_fenced_attempts':len(runs),'failed_attempts_retained':sum(v['returncode']!=0 for v in inventory)},sort_keys=True))
